subject: Film & Cinema
title: Rotoscoping and Hybrid Techniques
description: A short lesson to help you apply Rotoscoping and Hybrid Techniques.

hook.text: What if you traced real actors and turned them into animation? That's rotoscoping.

buildup.text: Invented by the Fleischers in 1915, rotoscoping bridges live action and drawn animation.

discovery.text: Richard Linklater used it for Waking Life and A Scanner Darkly — dreamy, shimmering visuals.

twist.text: AI now automates rotoscoping in hours. What took months of hand-tracing is nearly instant.

climax.text: Hybrid techniques keep expanding what animation can look and feel like.

punchline.text: The line between live and animated keeps blurring.

quiz.question: What is rotoscoping?
options: Tracing over live-action footage to create realistic animation
